Name: Azrikam, Governor of the House
Summary: Azrikam, governor of the house, was slain by Zichri of Ephraim in Pekah's invasion of Judah.
KeyStory: Zichri slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah next to the king.
LifeLesson: Officers of a faithless court fell with the kingdom they served.
